# Introduction

This report analyzes customer characteristics from the CardioGoodFitness dataset.

# Load Packages

```{r setup}
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Connect to PostgreSQL

```{r}

con <- dbConnect(
  RPostgres::Postgres(),
  dbname = "statistics",
  host = "localhost",
  port = 5432,
  user = "postgres",
  password = "YOUR_PASSWORD"
)

```

# Load Data

```{r}

cardio <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  'SELECT * FROM cardio_good_fitness'
)

head(cardio)

```

# Descriptive Statistics

```{r}

summary(cardio)

```

# Income Distribution

```{r}

ggplot(cardio,
       aes(x = "Product",
           y = "Income")) +
  geom_boxplot()

```
